Interface LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor

Enclosing interface:
LogEventFactory
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor
A source of ambient key values (MDC like context) for events whose logging API has no context of its own, such as JUL or System.Logger. Each supported store of ambient key values registers one with register(ServiceRegistry, Source, KeyValuesContributor), usually from a RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator.

Only the stores listed in LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard can contribute. When more than one is registered they are merged in the declaration order of LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard, so on a key collision the later constant wins. A logging facade that has its own context store excludes its own LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source when resolving the rest and passes its own key values to keyValues(KeyValues), which places them above every other source except LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.USER.

clear() clears the current thread's context in every store, for example when a pooled thread finishes a task: 

KeyValuesContributor.global().clear();
Appender buffers kept per thread are cleared separately with LogAppender.clearThreadLocals().
API Note
Rainbow Gum core deliberately has no API for putting key values into a context. Contributors only expose (and clear) whatever context store the application already uses.

  • Method Details

    • keyValues

      KeyValues keyValues()
      Key values for an event being created on the current thread. Called once per event on the logging thread so it should be cheap. It must not throw or log and should return KeyValues.of() when there is nothing to contribute. The returned key values may be live (not a copy) as long as they are not modified while the event is being created.
      Returns:
      key values, never null.

    • keyValues

      default KeyValues keyValues(KeyValues own)
      Like keyValues() but with a logging facade's own key values merged in above every contributor except LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.USER, which still wins.
      Parameters:
      own - the calling facade's own context, for example its MDC.
      Returns:
      merged key values, which is own itself when nothing else contributes.

    • clear

      default void clear()
      Clears all of the current thread's state in the underlying context store, including state that is not exposed as key values such as a nested diagnostic context (NDC) stack, so a pooled thread starts its next task with no context left over. A store that cannot be cleared this way, such as one bound to a scope, does nothing. Like keyValues() it must not throw or log. The default does nothing.
      See Also:
      • LogAppender.clearThreadLocals()

    • register

      static void register(ServiceRegistry registry, LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source source, LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor contributor)
      Registers the contributor for a context store. A store that is already registered is not replaced.
      Parameters:
      registry - usually LogConfig.serviceRegistry().
      source - which context store the contributor exposes.
      contributor - the contributor.

    • of

      static LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor of(ServiceRegistry registry, LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source... excluded)
      Combines the contributors currently registered in a service registry, skipping the excluded sources. The registry is read once on this call, so contributors registered afterward are not included.
      Parameters:
      registry - where contributors are registered.
      excluded - sources to skip, usually the caller's own.
      Returns:
      combined contributor, which returns KeyValues.of() if nothing is registered.

    • global

      static LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor global(LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source... excluded)
      Combines the contributors registered with whichever RainbowGum is bound globally at the time key values are requested, skipping the excluded sources. Meant for logging facades that route through LogRouter.global() and so cannot hold a reference to a particular Rainbow Gum.
      Parameters:
      excluded - sources to skip, usually the caller's own.
      Returns:
      contributor that follows the globally bound Rainbow Gum and returns KeyValues.of() while none is bound.
